classification.difficultyReason: Track the changed vertex correspondence using the given and shared angles, then assemble both whole sides from segments before forming the proportion for x.

content.prompt: In the figure below, $\angle B=\angle CED$. Prove that $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DEC$. Hence, determine the value of $x$.

spec.description: Triangle ABC with D on BC, E on AC and segment DE. Decorative pink fill omitted; all geometry remains editable.
spec.mathematics: BD=1, DC=3, AE=x, EC=2. Given angle ABC equals CED. Coordinates preserve this angle relationship without printing additional givens.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source labels and givens shown.

answer.short:
$\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DEC$ by AAA; $x=4$.

Use the given equal angles and the shared angle at $C$, then corresponding-side ratios.
answer.worked:
$\angle ABC=\angle CED$ (given).

$\angle ACB=\angle DCE$ (shared angle, since $D$ lies on $BC$ and $E$ lies on $AC$).

The remaining angles are equal, so $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DEC$ by AAA.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{AC}{DC}&=\frac{BC}{EC}\\\frac{x+2}{3}&=\frac{1+3}{2}\\x+2&=6\\x&=4.\end{align*}$$
